reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a coherent system: player prop generation uses historical and synthetic data to estimate marginal distributions; the Student-t copula links these through empirical correlations, enabling joint SGP pricing; DFS optimization applies combinatorial constraints to select high-value lineups. Each layer builds upon the previous, with failure modes tied to data integrity (e.g., missing players, stale props) and model assumptions (e.g., Gaussianity of residuals, fixed degrees of freedom). The system exhibits duality between probabilistic inference (GSI) and strategic optimization (GSE), where each component must validate inputs before proceeding. The epistemic trace reveals that all components rely on a shared data pipeline and validation gates, ensuring consistency across domains.
